drhp.business: The Company manufactures inorganic pigments and surfactants & specialty chemicals, with pigment capacity also housed in a wholly owned subsidiary at Naidupeta, Andhra Pradesh. Surfactants are the larger and faster-growing chemicals stream, produced at Ranipet (Tamil Nadu) and Naidupeta, and the Company is deliberately shifting mix toward higher-value specialty chemicals. Alongside chemicals it owns wind turbine generators whose output is consumed captively at its Ranipet and Ambattur plants, and it runs an IT-enabled services division serving external clients.

risks.note: Management states that geopolitical developments in West Asia during Q4 led to a sharp increase in key input prices across both Pigments and Surfactants, and that Q4 margins were impacted by steep increases in prices of key inputs — with the effect flagged as possibly continuing into future periods. Raw-material cost pass-through is therefore the primary margin risk.
risks.risk: Key input price volatility driven by West Asia geopolitics

risks.note: The same geopolitical developments are said to have caused disruptions in supply chain stability which may continue to impact future periods; supply chain disruption is also cited as one reason the subsidiary's CICP plant under-ran its capacity.

US tariffs hit exports during the year — standalone export revenue fell to Rs 176 Crores from Rs 184 Crores in FY25 — and the Company had to compensate by expanding volumes in other global markets. Exports remain a large share of turnover (Rs 226 Crores of Rs 775 Crores consolidated), so trade-policy shifts move the top line directly; tariff-related issues are also named as a drag on the subsidiary's plant utilisation.

The subsidiary's CICP plant recorded lower-than-anticipated capacity utilisation after the Naidupeta expansion was completed, on abnormal input costs, supply chain disruptions and tariff issues. Fixed costs from the new 3550 MT per annum capacity are being carried without full absorption.
risks.risk: Ramp-up risk on newly commissioned pigment capacity

risks.note: Standalone inorganic pigments revenue declined to Rs 164 Crores from Rs 175 Crores, so consolidated pigment growth rested entirely on the subsidiary's newly commissioned capacity. The legacy pigments stream is contracting while surfactants carry group growth.
risks.risk: Structural weakness in the inorganic pigments business

risks.note: Surfactants and specialities grew 14% to Rs 489 Crores and led overall 9% revenue growth, making group performance dependent on one stream; the Company reports it has already achieved optimum capacity utilisation at Ranipet and only further improved utilisation at Naidupeta, so incremental volume growth from existing assets is limited.
risks.risk: Concentration of growth in the surfactants segment with utilisation headroom largely used up

risks.note: Management explicitly states the following year will see impact from austerity measures, sharply rising fuel costs and the prevailing economic condition, both domestic and global.
risks.risk: Macroeconomic and energy cost headwinds in the coming year

risks.note: Operations are concentrated at Ranipet and Ambattur in Tamil Nadu and Naidupeta in Andhra Pradesh, with all seven wind turbine generators sited at three locations in Tamil Nadu supplying the Ranipet and Ambattur plants; a regional disruption would affect both production and captive power at once.
risks.risk: Geographic concentration of manufacturing and captive energy assets
